description: This source file implements functions related to network interfaces on Linux, including retrieving network list, interface connection types, and Wi-Fi SSID, with platform-specific code for Android and Linux.

methods.name: TryConvertNativeToNetIPAttributes
methods.description: Converts native IPv6 address attributes to network IP address attributes, filtering out addresses still in DAD process.

methods.name: GetInterfaceConnectionType
methods.description: Determines the connection type (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, etc.) for a given network interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID for a given wireless interface.

methods.name: GetNetworkListImpl
methods.description: Populates a list of network interfaces with their details based on current system state.

methods.name: GetWifiSSIDFromInterfaceListInternal
methods.description: Extracts the SSID from a list of network interfaces if all are Wi-Fi and SSIDs match.

methods.name: GetSocketForIoctl
methods.description: Creates and returns a socket for ioctl system calls.

methods.name: GetNetworkList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of network interfaces available on the system, with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: GetWifiSSID
methods.description: Returns the current Wi-Fi SSID, using platform-specific APIs.
